description: Policy defined after Phase 1 header review, before Phase 2. Select only dates, election codes/types and non-person provincial geography. Electoral outcomes, candidacies, party labels and seats are excluded.

Elecciones-Congreso-cargos-electos.xlsx.dedup_caveat: This is a geographic-date key, not a candidate or elected-office record key. Repeats are expected and cannot be adjudicated as row duplicates.

Elecciones-Congreso.xlsx.dedup_caveat: No safe unique key for each outcome metric row using metadata-only columns. Duplicate row counts must remain unknown.
